list.description: This field will have the Dashboard Time-range applied to it as a filter
list.label: Time-range filtering field
list.name: cubeTimeDimension

options.content:
The dashboard time dimension is **customer_directory.created_at** (view A).

Open the **Filters** bar and pick the key **payments_overview.payment_method** (view B), then open its value dropdown.

There are no other ad-hoc filters set: the only thing the value lookup can send to Cube is the dashboard time range on a dimension from a *different* view.
